rationale: The candidate is a faceted, wedge-like mass that is visually inconsistent across views and does not sustain one clear long-span hall reading. The silhouette feels more like an irregular compressed shell than a gymnasium: there is no clean dominant volume, no subordinate service bar, and no legible roof/section logic that implies span, structure, or daylight. The top view is especially weak as a thin extruded strip with a localized bulge, while the perspective views show a slanted, almost sculptural object rather than a programmatically coherent sports hall. There is also no meaningful public void or ground seam at the access edge, so the primary frontage reads sealed rather than welcoming. As a result, program appropriateness and section-program fit fail the hard gate.
